deathSays.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Christian Wen. Community gardener. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dead Phone, Unnamed photograph, Field suture kit, Knife roll, Lucky Coin. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The stars are wrong. They move when you aren't looking. Yesterday there were seven. Tonight there are nine. They're getting closer.
